question: Which shippers had daily pallet counts greater than 5% of their node capacity in Feb 2026?

       s.shipper_name,
       s.node_id,
       s.pickup_date,
       SUM(s.pallets) AS shipper_pallets,
       n.daily_capacity_pallets,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.pallets) / n.daily_capacity_pallets, 1) AS pct_of_node_capacity
FROM v_shipments s
JOIN nodes n
  ON n.node_id = s.node_id
WHERE s.pickup_date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
  AND s.is_cancelled = 0
GROUP BY s.shipper_id,
         s.shipper_name,
         s.node_id,
         s.pickup_date,
         n.daily_capacity_pallets
HAVING SUM(s.pallets) > 0.05 * n.daily_capacity_pallets
ORDER BY pct_of_node_capacity DESC;

ai_answer: **33 shipper-node-day combinations** exceeded 5% of their node's daily pallet capacity in February 2026, covering **15 different shippers**. The highest share was 7.3% of capacity, reached by three shipper-days at node N-UK-01 (S0020 on 9 Feb, S0027 on 9 Feb, and S0216 on 3 Feb), and the lowest flagged share was 5.1%. This uses pickup dates from 1 to 28 February 2026, excludes cancelled shipments, and totals each shipper's pallets per destination node per day against that node's daily capacity.
